intro.title: White Coral Stone
intro.descriptionHtml: The White Coral is a delightful white-colored gemstone that is considerably different in structure from other gemstones because it does not form on the Earth's surface. While Coral is the exoskeleton, or tough exterior, of the Polyp, a delicate marine organism. It is a well-known stone in Vedic astrology and is donned for financial success, mental calmness, perseverance, and healthy offspring.

tabs.tab1_description:
White Coral gemstone has a high luster and shine that draws everyone's attention to it. The white coral stone has powerful metaphysical and healing properties, and it promotes communication and self-confidence. White coral stone's healing properties help with piles and diseases of the lungs and kidneys.

White coral gemstones can be worn as wedding ornaments such as white coral engagement rings, wedding rings, necklaces, bracelets, and so on to look stunning and extravagant. The white coral stone balances mental and physical energies and boosts confidence and determination. Coral has always been regarded to possess sacred powers. It is said that ancient Egyptians used White Coral to ward off the evil spirits by placing them in the Tombs and Europe and Scandinavia to use it to ward off the evil.

White Coral stone was used to protect from attack of pirates and 'sea monsters' in olden days. The Greeks and European Anglo-Saxons used to respect the effectiveness of the Coral. It was used to decorate weapons by the Norwegians. Trading of Coral between Indian and the Mediterranean coasts was also significant in ancient times.

It is believed that white coral aids in emotional healing by fostering feelings of tranquility, balance, and emotional equilibrium. It is believed to assist in relieving anxiety, stress, and negative emotions. Given that white coral is composed primarily of calcium carbonate, it is associated with promoting bone and skeletal wellness. It is believed to aid in bone strengthening, healthy bone development, and fracture healing.

White coral is frequently regarded as a protective gemstone that can ward off evil spirits and avert misfortunes. It is believed to surround the wearer with a shield of positive energy, delivering a sense of safety and security. White coral is believed to heighten spiritual consciousness and intuition. It is believed to promote a deeper connection with one's inner self and open channels of communication with higher realms.

The mystic aura of this gemstone is a result of its metaphysical properties, which invite people to use the gemstone to assist themselves and lead them to spiritual awakening and fulfillment. Having faith in something gives it the ability to work in your favor.

Numerous holistic places and relaxation spots have used white coral stone as a foundational material. White coral is known to induce a sense of peace and tranquility in enclosed areas where people seek a moment of silence.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although White Coral gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing White Coral. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Crown Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

White Coral gemstone is beneficial for those feeling abandoned, lonely or hopeless. It is highly recommended for sadhaks or meditators to enhance their spiritual experience. This is an affordable gemstone for those who need guidance and place themselves in the right path in their lives. Also beneficial for those confused and dissatisfied with life.

Important Details: 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated White Coral gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated White Coral gemstones.

White Coral Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Italy remains the country where white coral is most prevalent. In addition, there are the Mediterranean Sea, Sardinia, the Bay of Biscay, Japan, Australia, and the Hawaiian Islands.

Observe their Color:

White Coral is available in brilliant pure white and opaque off-white hues.

Notice their Clarity:

White coral usually appears opaque or semi-translucent, preventing light from passing through it easily.

Examine their Inclusions:

White Coral may have organic patterns, lines, or spots that contribute to its beauty and distinctive qualities. These patterns may differ from stone to stone, providing every single piece of white coral a unique look.

See their Shape:

White coral is a versatile gemstone that can be cut and carved into many different shapes, such as beads, cabochons, ovals, and rounds, depending on the design or use. Because white coral is relatively soft compared to other gemstones, it is often used for carvings.

Check the Carats:

For White Coral of gem quality, the raw White Coral is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, White Coral weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because White Coral is sold by weight, White Coral prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity White Coral has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated White Coral:

Due to treatments the White Coral stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated White Coral do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate:

It is recommended that you should purchase White Coral gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our White Coral are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy White Coral from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used White Coral gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated White Coral gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of White Coral is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

The best quality White Coral is a brilliant, gleaming white.

Cut

Best quality White Coral stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

White Coral of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger White Coral are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of White Coral rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Best quality White Coral gemstones have a beautiful shiny white appearance.

Dealers deal in White Coral stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

White Coral gemstone Price

The price of White Coral gemstone depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color and clarity. White coral is an affordable gemstone, just make sure buy it untreated.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. White Coral has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated White Coral stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated White Coral gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 2,100 to INR 7,590 (USD 26 to USD 94.88).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic White Coral?

The best way to check the authenticity of White Coral is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our White Coral are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the White Coral carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a White Coral is genuine. Lab-created (fake) White Coral have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural White Coral, but if you find flaws, then your White Coral is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created White Coral are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural White Coral. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the White Coral, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your White Coral from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the White Coral. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the White Coral. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

White Coral Cleaning & Maintenance

When wearing white coral, care must be taken not to scratch or damage it, as it is softer than the majority of gemstone minerals and numerous organic substances.

White coral catches fire at relatively low temperatures. Additionally, it may darken with prolonged exposure to light and is susceptible to chemical damage.

Only warm, soapy water can be used to safely clean white coral.
